faq.q: What is the origin of Amirmohammad?
faq.a: Amirmohammad is associated with Arabic. Amirmohammad is a Persian compound of Arabic أَمِير (amīr, 'prince') + مُحَمَّد (Muḥammad).
Yes — the underlying form أَمِير مُحَمَّد is Arabic.
Amirmohammad can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Amirmohammad should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Muḥammad is not a Quranic personal name, though the root ح م د is Quranic.

faq.q: What does Amirmohammad mean in Urdu?

faq.q: What does Amirmohammad mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Amirmohammad is rendered امیرمحمد and carries the sense امیرمحمد، امیر محمد.
A romanized syllable approximation is a-mir-mo-ham-mad. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Amirmohammad, amirmohammad. Script forms are أَمِير مُحَمَّد, امير محمد, امیر محمد, امیرمحمد, अमीर मुहम्मद.
